title: The leak scan reads a prose secret assignment followed by a comma, bracket or backtick as a placeholder and passes it
goal: kbpublic.file_hits flags an unquoted prose secret assignment whose value is followed by , ) ] } or a backtick, as it flags one followed by a full stop or a space; the adversarial corpus gains secret rows for the comma, parenthesis, bracket, brace and backtick layouts

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbpublic as p;v='Pass'+'12345x';r=[bool([h for h in p.file_hits('kb/public/x.md',t,{}) if h[0]=='secret']) for t in ['the password: '+v+', then rotate','(password='+v+')','password=`'+v+'`']];print(r);sys.exit(0 if all(r) else 1)

import json,re,sys;d=json.load(open('_tools/fixtures/redact/adversarial.json'));T=[s['text'] for s in d['secrets']];r={c:any(re.search(r'\{v\}'+re.escape(c),t) for t in T) for c in [',',')',']','}','`']};print(r);sys.exit(0 if all(r.values()) else 1)

gates.question: How does the scan keep a closed code reference (api_key=token_provider, a path) from being flagged once , ) ] } and backticks no longer make a value a placeholder?
options: Exempt a snake_case name or a path only when closing punctuation was stripped
Strip the punctuation with no exemption and edit the tracked docs that then hit
Strip only for values holding a digit and an upper-case letter
gates.recommendation: Exempt a snake_case name or a path only when closing punctuation was stripped
gates.answer: Exempt a snake_case name or a path only when closing punctuation was stripped
